parts.name: board_geta
sources: The board (dai): paulownia of 15 mm, 270 kg/m3 (Paulownia tomentosa, air dry, Komán), by eye from the photos.

parts.name: hanao_geta
sources: The thong (hanao): cloth over cotton, 12 mm (by eye), from a hole at the front, knotted under the board, to a hole at each side at 30% of the foot (the photo of Wikimedia Commons, Geta (wooden clogs)); the density of cotton (The Engineering ToolBox).

parts.name: teeth_geta
sources: The two teeth (ha): paulownia, 45 mm high and 20 mm thick, at 20% and 75% of the last (by eye from the photos).
